subject: 23 Sycamore Avenue Research and Manufacturing Facility
overview: The board approved a special permit for a new life science research and manufacturing facility at 23 Sycamore Avenue and granted a permit extension for BJ’s Wholesale Club. Routine matters, including the review of the board's rules of order and prior minutes, were continued to a later date.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Continued approval of the July 2021 minutes to the next meeting.

items.title: BJ's Wholesale Club Permit Extension
items.summary: Approved a request to toll the expiration of the special permit for 278 Middlesex Avenue until one year after the final judicial resolution of a fuel storage permit appeal.

items.title: 23 Sycamore Avenue Special Permit
items.summary: Approved a special permit and site plan review for Oxford Properties Group to renovate a warehouse into a research and manufacturing facility. The approval is subject to conditions including further board review of the facade design and utility screening, the use of electric vehicle charging stations, and the installation of a new mid-block crosswalk on Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Board Rules and Regulations
items.summary: Continued the discussion regarding updated rules and regulations until a meeting with more members present.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Scheduling
items.summary: Staff briefed the board on the reimagined 200 Boston Avenue proposal and the draft climate adaptation plan, and scheduled the next meeting for September 15, 2021.
